title: SoFi Stock (SOFI) Soars 15% on Record Quarter, Crypto Reaches 503,000 Products
summary: Bitcoin Magazine SoFi Stock (SOFI) Soars 15% on Record Quarter, Crypto Reaches 503,000 Products SoFi shares jumped 14.6% to $16.56 after a record third quarter, with crypto reaching 503,070 products and adjusted EPS of $0.18 beating estimates. This post SoFi Stock (SOFI) Soars 15% on Record Quarter, Crypto Reaches 503,000 Products first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
